summary: Travel review giant losing ground to AI trip planners that synthesize full itineraries without a click.
moat: TripAdvisor holds over 1 billion reviews covering 8 million accommodations, restaurants, and attractions — a corpus of human travel experience built over 25 years. Its traveler photos and forum threads provide nuanced firsthand knowledge. The threat is structural: AI travel planners like Gemini and ChatGPT synthesize this accumulated knowledge into instant itineraries, bypassing TripAdvisor as the interface.

challengers.name: Google Gemini and AI travel planning assistants
challengers.evidence: Google's Gemini can generate full multi-day travel itineraries with hotel recommendations, restaurant picks, and budget estimates in seconds, directly intercepting TripAdvisor's core discovery use case.
